### 1. What the user expresses; simulator behaviour

- Target object: straight bill of lading `AHLU2609238451` (opening line: "chasing the notify party correction on bill AHLU2609238451 and need the corrected bill issued"). Timing: today. Boundary of action: get the notify-party correction made and the corrected bill issued. Authorisation: "happy for the agent to do whatever the line has to do on its side to get there".
- Identity: phone `+442072184913` + customer code `AHL-GB-274106` (two attributes, one verification call).
- Simulator is passive: never suggests a step; reveals the originals' whereabouts only when asked about the original bills ("the three originals of the corrected bill issued on 3 September are in the document folder you have with you, because you are standing at the line's Felixstowe documentation counter"); executes the user tool only when the agent hands it over ("lodge exactly the originals the agent tells you to lodge at the counter"); accepts the correction fee, pays nothing today.

### 5. Executable tool sequence, owners, dependencies, terminal state

1. agent `find_customers(phone_number)` → agent `verify_customer_identity(customer_id, phone_number, customer_code)`.
2. agent lookups: `find_bills_of_lading(bl_number)`, `find_bol_service_requests`, `find_bol_ledger`, `find_bookings`.
3. agent asks about the original bills → simulator reveals she has the three originals at the Felixstowe counter.
4. agent `unlock_user_discoverable_tool("return_originals_for_correction_b9bd03b3")`, gives bl_id / 2 / 3 → user `call_user_discoverable_tool` → "Lodgement bse_… 3 original(s) of set 2 handed in at the origin office"; record shows originals_outstanding 0.
5. agent unlock + call `apply_particular_correction_a24e9121(bl_id, booking_id, request_id=82ed…, notify_party_name, verbatim value)` → request completed.
6. agent unlock + call `charge_correction_fee_18211c73(bl_id, booking_id, request_id=82ed…, 150.00)`.
7. agent unlock + call `issue_corrected_set_a7062696(bl_id, request_id=82ed…, 3, 3)`.
- backward dependencies: 5 needs 4; 6 needs 5; 7 needs 6 and 4. Terminal state (observed on replay): status issued, set 3, notify party rewritten, originals outstanding 3, charges due 300.00, request 82ed… completed; lodgement and new-originals entries in history.
- Observation: the rewrite tool executes even with 3 originals outstanding (replayed on a fresh seed); ordering is therefore carried by policy alone, not by tool guards.

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials

Root: the customer asks for the notify-party correction and the corrected bill.

| Problem | Owner | Tool |
|---|---|---|
| P1 lodge the outstanding set-2 originals at origin | user (printed shipper) | return_originals_for_correction_b9bd03b3 |
| P2 rewrite the notify party, close the request | agent | apply_particular_correction_a24e9121 |
| P3 book the correction fee on the executed request | agent | charge_correction_fee_18211c73 |
| P4 issue the corrected set | agent | issue_corrected_set_a7062696 |

Hops (direction "blocked ← depended-on"):

- **H1 P2 ← P1.** Combination: return_of_originals cl.1 "a correction to an issued document takes effect only in a state where no original of the set in force is outstanding … The record of originals outstanding on the document is the evidence" + record `originals_outstanding` 3, Straight = Yes → P2 cannot stand now; lodging_originals "The originals of that document still in circulation are then lodged with the line at the origin office" + "Only the shipper printed on the document can hand in its originals" + simulator location → P1 is the act that brings the figure to 0. Derivable by combination — but also **read off**: originals_back_correction_process "The rewrite of the particular relies on the lodgement."; and return_of_originals illustration "An `AHL Straight Bill of Lading` in set 1 has three originals in circulation, and a correction of the notify party is on file. With two of the three originals back … the new notify party cannot yet stand on the document. With the third returned … the corrected document goes out as set 2".
- **H2 P3 ← P2.** Combination: correction_fee_booking "A fee entry is correct only for a correction request whose particular reads, on the document, in the new wording or figure requested" + record notify party still "Delacroix Tableware Imports Inc." → P3 must follow P2. Derivable — but **read off**: originals_back_correction_process "The correction fee relies on the rewrite."
- **H3 P4 ← P3.** Combination: corrected_set_issue "A corrected set is issued only as a complete documentary package. Completeness means that, at the moment of issue, the documentation account of the document holds the correction fee owed on the correction request that the set carries" + ledger has no fee row on 82ed… → P3 before P4. Derivable (the principle itself already names the other problem's result) — and **read off**: originals_back_correction_process "The corrected set relies on the correction fee."
- **H4 P4 ← P1.** originals_outstanding_figure cl.4 "That zero does not allow the corrected set to be issued while originals of the earlier set are still in circulation" and Q&A "Can the corrected set be issued with zero new originals so that the original still out is simply left where it is? No." → **read off**; also originals_back_correction_process "It relies on the lodgement as well".
- **H0 that P3 and P4 are owed at all** (customer named only "corrected bill", not the fee): correction_fee_booking "Each such correction gives rise to exactly one correction fee entry"; return_of_originals cl.3 "After the correction, the document is issued afresh as the next set of originals" — derived from the scope of those rules.

Resulting order: P1 → P2 → P3 → P4. The whole route (four parts, their owners, what each relies on, and the situation — issued paper document of a return type, open correction, holder = printed shipper present at origin with the originals) is laid out in one document, originals_back_correction_process, so every hop of this tree is readable from that page.

### Two-way counter-proof

- Support: every value above rests on the quoted sentences and the tool returns listed.
- Closest alternatives excluded:
  - before-departure rate 75.00 → excluded by vessel_departure_record cl.1–3 (booking `departed_date` 2026-09-02) and correction_fee_by_sailing_stage "the test is the position at the moment the correction is charged";
  - free correction → Straight free allowance 0 (amendment_charges table) and correction_fee_by_sailing_stage cl.1 "never inside a free allowance"; keying error not evidenced;
  - lodging 6 (all ever issued) → balance formula deducts surrenders; caller-count irrelevant ("never taken from a figure the caller supplies");
  - lodgement set 1 → set-1 originals are fully back (2+1 surrendered), outstanding originals belong to set 2;
  - corrected set numbered 2 → record set 2 is in force; next set is 3;
  - corrected set with 0 originals → excluded by originals_outstanding_figure cl.3 (figure 0 after lodgement) and corrected_set_shipment_status (departed). Residual reading risk: approved_status_at_issue cl.3 "When the document is in any other status (draft, issued, …), no originals are put into circulation through the issue" and its Q "A document already issued is presented for issue again. Are fresh originals put into circulation? No." could be read as covering the corrected set (the document is 'issued' at the corrected issue). The more specific corrected-set pages (corrected_set_issue "Its originals are put into circulation", corrected_set_originals_count "Each circumstance that the corrected-set rules describe …", return_of_originals cl.3) and the ledger precedent (set 2 put 3 originals into circulation on 2026-09-03 on an issued document) make 3 the better-supported reading; recorded as observation O0-1 for the source scan.
  - collecting payment / waiver → not requested; customer pays with the next invoice run.
- "Do only what the customer asked" (rewrite the notify party, then issue the bill): excluded by return_of_originals cl.1 with `originals_outstanding` 3 (the rewrite would alter a document the rules forbid altering in that state), by corrected_set_issue completeness (no fee on the request), and by originals_outstanding_figure cl.4. Excludable by reasoning from visible principles and records — but the same exclusion is also stated outright in originals_back_correction_process ("What each part relies on"), so those hops are marked read off.
